## The problem or use case

What are you trying to build? For example: "I want a chat message to fly into the trash icon when deleted".

## Proposed solution

How you would like it to work, ideally with the API you have in mind:

```tsx
await dissolve({ preset: 'my-variant' });
```

## Alternatives considered

Other variants, hooks or libraries you tried.

## References

Links, videos or apps that show the effect.
